description.short: Portfolio MI answers and latest Trakt artefacts in Copilot.
description.full: Ask Trakt portfolio MI questions and retrieve the latest generated Trakt artefacts (investor deck, canonical loan tape, mapping report, validation report, ESMA Annex 2 XML). Answers come from Trakt's deterministic MI engine — never model estimation. When a question is better explored interactively, Trakt links you into the Trakt MI Workspace.
